{{Short description|Norwegian nuclear physicist (1922–2014)}}
'''Viking Olver Eriksen''' (14 April 1922 – 6 March 2014) was a Norwegian [[nuclear physicist]].

He was born in [[Stavanger]], and graduated as [[cand.real.]] in 1951. In 1952 he was hired at the Institute for Nuclear Energy at [[Kjeller]]&mdash;the institution is now named the [[Norwegian Institute for Energy Technology]]&mdash;as head of the physics department. He left this position in 1965 to become assisting director. In 1968 he was managing director for a brief time, from 1971 to 1982 he held this position on a permanent basis.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia |year=2007 |title=Eriksen, Viking Olver |encyclopedia=Aschehoug og Gyldendals Store norske leksikon |publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget |location= |url=http://snl.no/Viking_Olver_Eriksen }}</ref>

He died in [[Lillestrøm]] in March 2014 at the age of 91.<ref>[https://snl.no/Viking_Olver_Eriksen SNL: Viking Olver Eriksen bio]</ref>
